title: Vehicle Service Contracts Rate Card: Deductibles, Lifetime Claim Limits and Labor Rates
content:
For Vehicle Service Contracts, the deductible per repair visit, the lifetime claim limit and the highest labor rate the administrator pays are set by DriveSure plan as follows.

| Plan | Deductible per repair visit (USD) | Lifetime claim limit (USD) | Labor rate cap (USD per hour) |
|---|---|---|---|
| DriveSure Powertrain | 200.00 | 5000.00 | 125.00 |
| DriveSure Powertrain Plus | 150.00 | 7500.00 | 135.00 |
| DriveSure Silver | 100.00 | 10000.00 | 145.00 |
| DriveSure Gold | 100.00 | 12500.00 | 155.00 |
| DriveSure Platinum | 100.00 | 15000.00 | 165.00 |
| DriveSure Exclusionary | 50.00 | 20000.00 | 175.00 |

**Column meanings.** The deductible is charged per repair visit, in USD. The lifetime claim limit is the maximum total of authorized claims over the life of the service contract, in USD. The labor rate cap is the highest labor rate the administrator pays, in USD per hour.

**Terms common to every plan.**

- How the deductible applies: once per repair visit, whatever the number of covered components repaired.
- How authorized claims are paid: paid by the administrator directly to the repair facility, less the deductible.

**Illustrations (hypothetical repair visits).**

- A DriveSure Powertrain repair visit in which the engine and the transmission are both repaired carries one deductible of 200.00, not two.
- A repair facility billing labor at 170.00 per hour on a DriveSure Gold claim is paid labor at no more than 155.00 per hour; on a DriveSure Exclusionary claim the same rate is within the 175.00 cap.
